body.x: Dae-A Industrial participated in the “2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)” from October 23 to October 26 at Daegu EXCO, showcasing its EV Cooling Tube designed to enhance the stability of driving systems and provide optimal interior comfort.

Founded in 1979, Dae-A Industrial has continuously grown as a leader in extrusion technology. Since developing its first automotive corrugated tube in 1986, the company has introduced nylon and flame-retardant nylon corrugated tubes and nylon armoring tubes.

After 2000, the company acquired multiple certifications, including IATF16949 and SQ certifications, and began mass production of degassing cubes and cooler tubes. In 2023, it participated in carbon neutrality innovation projects and received the Daegu City Quality Circle Excellence Award in 2024.

The EV Cooling Tube, a bellows-type product for electric vehicles, was the centerpiece of the company’s display. It applies to motor cooling systems, high-voltage battery cooling lines, battery reservoir lines, and battery module cooling systems.
Thermal management in electric vehicles is vital for maintaining system stability during driving and for efficient heating and cooling of the interior.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
